userimpact-heading: Heading above the impact panel shown on a user's own user page.
userimpact-total-edits: Label for the total-edits stat tile.
userimpact-last-edited: Label for the last-edited stat tile.
userimpact-streak: Label for the longest-edit-streak stat tile.
userimpact-days: Value shown in the streak tile. $1 is the number of days.
userimpact-no-edits: Shown instead of a date in the last-edited tile when the user has no edits.
userimpact-activity-heading: Heading above the 60-day edit activity bar chart.
userimpact-period-edits-label: Label shown next to the big period-total number above the activity chart. $1 is the count, used only for plural selection.
userimpact-views-heading: Heading above the list of most-viewed articles the user has edited.
userimpact-total-views: Summary line above the most-viewed articles list. $1 is the total view count.
userimpact-preference-show: Label for the checkbox in Special:Preferences that lets a user opt in or out of seeing their impact panel.
prefs-userimpact: Heading for the preferences section containing the impact-panel visibility checkbox, on the User profile tab of Special:Preferences.
